name: Aspen-Pitkin County Airport (Sardy Field)

runway.v: one runway, 15/33, 8,006 ft (about 2,440 m) long and 100 ft (about 30 m) wide; it slopes uphill about 2% to the southeast; field elevation 7,815 ft
runway.quote: The runway was updated to its present size of 8,006 feet long by 100 feet wide

curfew.v: mandatory curfew: the airport is closed 23:00-07:00 local; Stage 3 jets may not land 23:00-07:00 or take off 22:30-07:00; Stage 2 aircraft may not fly at night at all; only emergency flights (medevac, search and rescue, firefighting) are exempt
curfew.quote: No Person shall depart from the Airport in an Aircraft that is certificated as Stage III between 10:30 P.M. and 7:00 A.M. local time.

max_aircraft.v: no aircraft with a wingspan over 95 ft, or a maximum landing weight over 100,000 lb (dual wheel) or 160,000 lb (dual tandem); after the 2027 runway rebuild the wingspan limit is planned to rise to 118 ft
max_aircraft.quote: Has a tip-to-tip wingspan of greater than 95 feet

ppr.v: take-offs on runway 15 need a signed waiver (through Atlantic Aviation); night VFR (30 minutes after sunset to 23:00) needs a pilot with a take-off or landing at Aspen in the last 12 months, an instrument rating and an IFR-equipped aircraft
ppr.quote: Runway 15 takeoffs requires a waiver to be signed by Atlantic Aviation.

noise.v: Stage 1 aircraft banned; Stage 3 departures banned 22:30-07:00 (MST as stated); arrivals keep to the noise track with no more than 20 degrees of bank
noise.quote: No Person shall depart from the Airport in an Aircraft that is certificated as Stage III between 2230 and 0700 MST.

hours.v: airport closed 23:00-07:00 (stated as MST); control tower 07:00-20:00 (stated as MST). The airport will be fully closed from 4 Apr 2027 23:00 to 19 Nov 2027 19:00 for runway reconstruction (runway widened to 150 ft)

handling.v: the airport names Atlantic Aviation as its fixed base operator

deicing.v: the airport has a de-ice pad with the run-up area, east of taxiway Alpha; combined area 96,407 sq ft
deicing.quote: Aspen/Pitkin County Airport has a de-ice pad which is located in conjunction with the run-up area, east of taxiway Alpha;

customs.v: the airport has no international passenger processing facilities and says the closest CBP port of entry is Eagle County Regional Airport (KEGE)
customs.quote: Aspen/Pitkin County Airport does not have international passenger processing facilities.
